message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data sources are accessed in the visible code; data is loaded from local files/functions with no checksum, signature, or authentication checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data-preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only clamps age values and fills NaNs with sentinel values; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs that would constitute a poisoning defense.

No detected model integrity verification: The code serializes and deserializes a features DataFrame via pickle (lines ~100-108) with no hash check, signature verification, or integrity validation before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient-anomaly inspection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied; LGBMClassifier is used without any DP wrapper.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics; the code does a simple train/test split and computes uplift metrics without any tampering protection controls.

No detected input sanitization: The code applies a blanket fillna(-2) and clips age values but performs no shape/schema validation, range checks, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing features to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions are passed directly to save_submission() with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the model's output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses a LightGBM tabular classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
